item.description: The rivals have been grouped together again, along with holders Australia, as ICC announces schedule for the tournament. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Why are these endangered moths swarming Australia's east coast?
item.description: The sudden influx of Bogong moths has caused a stir in cities like Sydney and Canberra, with people filming them infiltrating their homes and cars. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: Parents outraged as trees chopped down at central Victorian schools
item.description: A Lone Pine tree and strawberry plants are among vegetation abruptly cleared from a central Victorian school as part of a state government tree removal program. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Anna McGuinness, Fiona Parker, Rebecca Norman, and Tyrone Dalton

item.title: A town, a team and a dream come together as Newcastle rises as one
item.description: Ahead of their first grand final in a generation, Newcastle is ready to hold the Knights closer to their hearts than ever before as team and city show why they are one. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Nick Campton

item.title: Judge denies Lindsay Clancy defence motion to find her not guilty
item.description: The judge in the Lindsay Clancy murder case has refused to declare her not guilty, turning down a defence motion that argued there was not enough evidence to prove she was responsible for killing her three children. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Statewide map shows where Tasmania's buildings face bushfire exposure
item.description: As bushfire season approaches, new modelling is giving Tasmanian communities a clearer picture of where fire could burn most severely. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Clancy Balen

item.title: Alleged 15yo driver killed, four others injured in Tasmanian crash
item.description: Tasmania Police say initial inquiries suggest the 15-year-old boy who died was driving the car when it crashed. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Beloved Melbourne market to have 900 apartments under redevelopment plan
item.description: Residential towers ranging in height from eight to 16 storeys would surround the market and include 10 per cent affordable housing under plans to redevelop the site. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Max Walden

item.title: Who wins your vote for the 2026 ABC Australian Insect of the Year?
item.description: Experts have nominated two butterflies, a pair of beetles, a signal fly and a glow-worm as 2026 ABC Insect of the Year finalists. Now you get to help decide the winner. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Gavin McGrath

item.title: Carlton continues push for AFLW top four in win over Hawks
item.description: Carlton have weathered wet and wild conditions to leap into the AFLW's top four with a 12-point win over Hawthorn. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: Firmus reportedly targets $7.1b raise in blockbuster IPO
item.description: The Australian share market is set to rebound after Wall Street recovered from early losses as US Treasury yields retreated from multi-decade highs. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lin Lin

item.title: Trade minister proposes super investment in US lamb to dodge tariffs
item.description: Trade Minister Don Farrell asks the Trump administration to consider sparing Australian sheep farmers from future tariffs in exchange for Australian investment in America's lamb industry. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Brad Ryan

item.title: Perth man jailed for AI-generated child exploitation material
item.description: Matthew John Woodward, 41, had pleaded guilty to dozens of counts of creating and possessing child exploitation material, which the District Court of Western Australia judge said was "appalling". Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: David Weber

item.title: Live: Gaming giants told to 'lift their game' on child safety
item.description: The eSafety Commission says it has identified gaps in harmful content detection, repeat-offender prevention and information-sharing initiatives in some gaming platforms. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Joshua Boscaini

item.title: Volunteers unite to help strangers and find Nannup Four
item.description: A team of citizen searchers has travelled from across the country to dense bushland in Western Australia's south in a bid to find the Nannup Four. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Dominique Bayens

item.title: Australia and India to kick off next year's Cricket World Cup
item.description: Australia will launch its defence of the men's Cricket World Cup in South Africa next year with a blockbuster opener against India, the powerhouse it defeated to win the crown in 2023. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Tasmania's notorious St Marys Pass upgrade could cost almost $3b
item.description: A notoriously windy stretch of road in Tasmania could be upgraded with pricing revealed to be as high as $2.7 billion to re-route the road. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Kelsey Reid

item.title: 'Way better than it sounds': The laksa-inspired dishes selling out in Darwin
item.description: From laksa cheesecake to toasties and deep fried ice cream, Darwin's annual laksa festival has something for all palettes. And while it might sound "weird", those cooking up a storm promise "it tastes way better than it sounds". Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: George Nicoll

item.title: Western Sydney home owners 'battening down the hatches'
item.description: Between interest rate and petrol price rises and falling house values, Western Sydney residents say making ends meet is getting tough. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Phoebe Pin, Charlie McLean, and Danuta Kozaki

item.title: Brisbane to Melbourne with no traffic lights, and no Big Banana
item.description: Businesses in Coffs Harbour are preparing for life without 35,000 vehicles driving daily through the city. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Claire Simmonds and Samuel O'Brien

item.title: Sarah Sutter was an inaugural Thunderbird. Now her daughter is making history
item.description: Jazmin Mckay has joined the Adelaide Thunderbirds as the club's inaugural mother-daughter signing, following in the footsteps of her mother, a dual premiership T-Bird and gold medal winning Diamond player. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Sophie Holder

item.title: Australian citrus growers miss out on millions without US export markets
item.description: There are calls for government departments to speed up decades-old negotiations as markets in Asian countries worsen and Australia faces citrus oversupply. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Vanessa Jarrett

item.title: Three jurisdictions will have a public holiday to ease into daylight saving time
item.description: This weekend, many Australians will experience a time warp, with their clocks jumping forward by an hour on Sunday morning. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Dannielle Maguire

item.title: PNG's NRL franchise faces trademark fight over Chiefs name
item.description: Australia's intellectual property agency tells PNG's rugby league franchise that its chosen name, the Chiefs, risks being confused with the name of a Super Rugby club. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Richard Ewart

item.title: Ultra-precise coatings help power the next generation of gravitational wave detectors
item.description: Researchers from The Australian National University (ANU) have engineered new optical coatings for LIGO, the global collaboration hunting gravitational waves from colliding black holes and neutron stars. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Renee Good’s family sues Trump administration over fatal ICE shooting
item.description: The family of Renee Good, one of two US citizens fatally shot by federal immigration agents in Minneapolis in January, has sued President Donald Trump's administration alleging negligence and civil rights violations. Publicado también por: ABC News Australia, Deutsche Welle - World. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Never played in Prem - and now face World Cup hosts
item.description: Jack Combes and Alex Post tell BBC Sport about a "dream come true" as they look ahead to the 2027 Rugby World Cup opener against hosts Australia. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: UK-Iranian national arrested over alleged terror incident at British air base
item.description: UK police arrested the 27-year-old in London on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts and said a second British man, 26, had also been questioned under caution. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
